author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Eight! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Matt Burns (Don't Look Back) and Black Site Studio return with a Dark Fantasy Horror game set in Sherwood Forest. The King has returned from the crusades and been usurped by the imposter John. Using dark magic from the riches returned from the wars, a curse settles over the land. Robin and his men seek to thwart it, but are slain by dark magic in the attempt. Years later the countryside rots and the rebels are a shadow of who they once were, but there is hope! Let's check it out!

Check out the FREE 50pages of Quickstart rules and FREE Poacher STL HERE https://blacksitestudio.com/en-ca/products/outlaws-quickstart-preview
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 078 - OUTLAWS by Matt Burns and BSS
